title: Carlo Pro Instant Water Heater (Geyser)
subtitle: 5.9 L White Blue
category: Home Appliances > Water Heaters / Geyser > Instant Water Heaters
key_features: Whirlflow Technology : 20 % more hot water output
Heavy Duty Protective Anode Rod : Protects the inner container from corrosion
Fire Retardant Power Cord : Fire retardant power cord for safety and protection
Feroglas Technology : This thick rolled steel tank is coated with feroglas which ensures high resistance against corrosion, making the water heater tough on hard water & giving them a longer life.
Heavy Duty Heating Element : It offers superior heating performance with its excellent resistance to corrosion. Thus, extending life span of heating element.
Anode Rod : The tank has an anode rod with a stainless-steel core that is designed to protect the tank from corrosive elements.
0.8 MPa High Working Pressure : Suitable for high rise buildings. The multi-function valve prevents pressure to increase beyond 8 bar
Water Resistance and Splash Proof (IPX 4) : Ensure high level of protection for electrical parts from water splashing.
Whirlflow Technology : It avoids direct contact between cold and hot water flow for a faster heating.
